title: A Playlist for the Scholarship
premise: August Galloway, a baker's son who channels feelings into bread, is paired with his nemesis Priya Chandrasekaran for a semester project that secretly decides who wins the Halloway Scholarship — the only way either of them can afford college. As they build a shared playlist-project, August discovers the scholarship committee has been rigging selections for years, and the evidence sits in a memory Priya has buried: her mother once exposed the same corruption and was destroyed for it. Torn between loyalty to Priya and the truth that could free them both, August bakes his testimony into a final audition loaf that makes the whole auditorium remember. In the end they expose the committee together, lose the scholarship on purpose, and win something better — each other's trust and a community-funded future.
about_author: Wendell Brightwater is a former high school debate coach who grew up above his grandmother's bakery in a rust-belt town. He writes stories about kids who are tired of being careful.

chapters.title: The Careful Boy
chapters.summary: August's POV. We meet August kneading grief-bread before dawn, twelve years after his father's scandal made the family pariahs. At school, Principal Voss announces the semester project that feeds into the Halloway Scholarship. The emotional beat: suffocating caution, and the first crack of wanting more.

chapters.title: Nemesis Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya, top of the class and ruthlessly strategic, is assigned to partner with August — the boy whose father ruined her mother's teaching career. She plans to use him and discard him. Emotional beat: cold fury masking fear that her mother's disgrace was never what it seemed.

chapters.title: Sourdough Diplomacy
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Forced collaboration begins; August brings bread to a late-night work session, and Priya accidentally reveals she keeps her mother's confiscated lesson plans. They agree on a playlist-based project mapping memory to music. Emotional beat: grudging respect kindling like an oven pilot light.

chapters.title: What the Committee Keeps
chapters.summary: August's POV. Researching archives for the project, August finds redacted records showing scholarship winners were pre-selected by donors — including one connected to his father's old business partner. Emotional beat: dread curdling into purpose; the careful boy starts taking risks.

chapters.title: Track Seven
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. A song on their shared playlist triggers Priya's suppressed memory of the night her mother came home broken — and of a document her mother hid in the attic. Emotional beat: memory as both wound and weapon; Priya chooses to dig.

chapters.title: The Attic Tape
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Together they find her mother's recording proving the committee rigged selections a decade ago. But using it means exposing themselves to Voss, who warns them quietly to stop. Emotional beat: loyalty vs. truth becomes literal — protect each other, or tell everyone?

chapters.title: Burnt Offerings
chapters.summary: August's POV. August burns a batch of bread the night he almost destroys the tape to keep Priya safe from reprisal. Priya catches him mid-ash and calls him a coward with love in her voice. Emotional beat: rupture; partnership shatters over the question of what protection really costs.

chapters.title: Preliminaries
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Separated, both compete alone in the scholarship preliminaries and realize the fix is already in — Voss's chosen candidate performs flawlessly with rehearsed answers. Emotional beat: despair sharpening into clarity; winning their game means refusing their rules.

chapters.title: The Final Audition
chapters.summary: August's POV, climax. At the final audition, August presents not a speech but bread baked from the whole story — grief, guilt, courage — while playing their playlist, and publicly plays Priya's mother's tape. The auditorium remembers; the room turns. Emotional beat: terror transmuted into testimony.

chapters.title: Breaking New Loaves
chapters.summary: Alternating POV, resolution. The committee resigns under pressure; August and Priya withdraw from the tainted scholarship, and the town funds both their futures instead. In the rebuilt bakery, they bake bread for the people who believed them. Emotional beat: truth kept them loyal to each other — memory, honored, sets them free.
